title: Nonconcentration of eigenfunctions in Microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym norms: a phase space approach
summary: Previous works of the author and Sogge [BS17], [BS18] showed the significance of microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym averages in improving $L^p$ bounds on (approximate) eigenfunctions of the Laplacian in the high frequency limit. These averages are formed by taking the $L^2$ norm of an eigenfunction when localized in phase space to a small, frequency-dependent tube about a geodesic segment via a pseudodifferential operator.
